title: Poonithura residents to stage dharna at KWA office over acute water shortage

ai.summary: Residents of Poonithura in Kerala plan a dharna at KWA office over severe drinking water shortage affecting nearly 70 households since October 2024, with authorities citing infrastructure issues and a proposed plant as long-term solutions.

facts.claim: Residents of Poonithura will stage a dharna at Kerala Water Authority (KWA) executive engineer’s office on Thursday, protesting the severe drinking water shortage in the region.
facts.quote: Residents of Poonithura will stage a dharna at Kerala Water Authority (KWA) executive engineer’s office on Thursday, protesting the severe drinking water shortage in the region.

facts.claim: Nearly 70 households on the southern side of Mukkottil Temple Road have been without a regular water supply since Oct 2024.
facts.quote: Nearly 70 households on the southern side of Mukkottil Temple Road have been without a regular water supply since Oct 2024.

facts.claim: The crisis has worsened over the past two months, cutting off water even to the remaining homes that previously had access.
facts.quote: The crisis has worsened over the past two months, cutting off water even to the remaining homes that previously had access.

facts.claim: The water shortage has extended to new areas like Thykoodam.
facts.quote: The water shortage has extended to new areas like Thykoodam.

facts.claim: KWA authorities cite a proposed 190 MLD plant at Aluva as a long-term solution.
facts.quote: KWA authorities, though, cite a proposed 190 MLD plant at Aluva as a long-term solution.

facts.claim: The water supply shortages in Poonithura and nearby localities stem from its tail-end position in the KWA distribution network, ageing pipelines, low pumping pressure, and infrastructure disruptions such as the partial collapse of the Thammanam water storage tank last year.
facts.quote: The water supply shortages in Poonithura and nearby localities stem from its tail-end position in the KWA distribution network, ageing pipelines, low pumping pressure, and infrastructure disruptions such as the partial collapse of the Thammanam water storage tank last year.

facts.claim: The only practical solution is the setting up of a new water tank at Vytilla to store the water and then supply to the affected areas.
facts.quote: The only practical solution is the setting up of a new water tank at Vytilla to store the water and then supply to the affected areas.

facts.claim: Despite repeated appeals, KWA has failed to take any concrete steps to restore the water supply, leaving the residents with no choice but to protest.
facts.quote: Despite repeated appeals, KWA has failed to take any concrete steps to restore the water supply, leaving the residents with no choice but to protest.
